name: Neural 3D Mesh Renderer (NMR)
definition: A differentiable rendering method that approximates the non-differentiable rasterization step by replacing sudden changes with linear interpolation changes, allowing gradients to flow to vertices from pixels beyond the boundary.
summary: Neural 3D Mesh Renderer is a differentiable rasterization method that enables end-to-end training by approximating visibility changes with linear interpolation while retaining standard z-culling.
